fields.name: requestId
fields.description: Unique id of the sync request.

fields.name: factoryId
fields.description: Id of the factory to sync.

fields.name: requestedAt
fields.description: ISO time the owner asked for the sync.

fields.name: plan
fields.description: JSON text of the sync plan.

fields.name: plannedAt
fields.description: ISO time the plan was made.

fields.name: result
fields.description: JSON text of the apply result.

fields.name: error
fields.description: Error text when the request failed.

fields.name: version
fields.description: Row version; bumped on every update.

fields.name: writeId
fields.description: Id of the write that produced this version.
